commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.

90+5' Tyler Dibling (Southampton) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but it's just a bit too high and misses the bar by a whisker. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
90+3' The attendance for today's match is 31059.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.

90' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
88' The substitution is prepared. Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Emerson.
87' Substitution. Adam Lallana (Southampton) in, Lesley Ugochukwu out.
86' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ryan Manning (Southampton) replacing Kyle Walker-Peters.
85' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:16. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:2.
82' Southampton are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

79' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball goes just a few inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
75' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
74' The free kick from long range, taken by Southampton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
73' Emerson (West Ham) commits a rough challenge and Lewis Smith blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to Southampton.
73' Here is a change. Mateus Fernandes is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Tyler Dibling (Southampton).
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Adam Armstrong walks off the pitch to be replaced by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton).

70' A sweet pass inside the box gives Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.

69' Close! Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
68' Here comes a substitution. Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) is brought on as a substitute for Guido Rodriguez.
68' Julen Lopetegui decides to make a substitution. Niclas Fullkrug will be replaced by Crysencio Summerville (West Ham).
67' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
66' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Southampton for a penalty. Play continues.
64' Southampton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
61' Ivan Juric has decided to substitute Yukinari Sugawara and he is replaced by James Bree (Southampton).
61' Substitution. Joe Aribo (Southampton) has come on for Flynn Downes.
59' 0 - 1 Gooal! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Niclas Fullkrug. He makes it 0:1.
59' Emerson (West Ham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
56' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Lewis Smith had an easy-decision to make.
53' Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
53' Confusion here but it seems that referee Lewis Smith has changed his mind following the VAR review and downgraded the red card shown to Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) to a yellow.

52' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Guido Rodriguez (West Ham), but referee Lewis Smith must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
51' The game is interrupted by the referee. He pulls out a red card and sends Guido Rodriguez (West Ham) off.
50' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
48' The West Ham players are exchanging some short passes.
46' Julen Lopetegui makes a switch. Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is coming on in place of Carlos Soler at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+11' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+9' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Alphonse Areola, who pulls off a comfortable save!
45+9' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
45+8' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
45+4' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) will take the corner.

45+4' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Southampton will have a chance to score from a corner.
45+3' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Aaron Ramsdale.
45+2' West Ham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.

44' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the left post from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
43' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
41' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) commits a rough foul. Lewis Smith stops the game and makes a call.

40' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Lewis Smith with no other option than to blow for a foul.
39' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
38' West Ham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
38' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to West Ham.
36' Julen Lopetegui is forced to make a change. Lukasz Fabianski is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Alphonse Areola (West Ham).
29' Lewis Smith shows a yellow card to Nathan Wood (Southampton) for his blatant foul.
29' The game is interrupted now, Lukasz Fabianski (West Ham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' A corner kick by Southampton is thwarted by the well prepared Lukasz Fabianski (West Ham).
27' The West Ham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
25' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Lukasz Fabianski, who pulls off a stunning save!

23' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
23' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
22' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
21' Lewis Smith blows his whistle. Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
19' Max Kilman is being substituted because of an injury. Julen Lopetegui sends Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) on the pitch.

18' What a save from Lukasz Fabianski! Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
15' Max Kilman (West Ham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
14' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
13' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
12' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from West Ham. The ratio of the ball possession is 51:49.

10' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
9' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) makes a strong challenge and Lewis Smith blows for a foul.
7' Southampton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
5' What a chance that is! Carlos Soler (West Ham) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!
3' Nathan Wood (Southampton) was too forceful with his tackle and Lewis Smith interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

1' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
